name: ocean-deep
jelliesFormat: [x, y] film-frame fractions (x right, y down), depth (m), body radius and light reach (fractions of the frame height); null when behind the lens

glow.note: the same take with ONLY the jellies' own light (everything else black); add it (plus-lighter) inside a soft disc of radius jellies[f][i][4] round each lit jelly. step 2: frame 2k+1 of glow.mp4 repeats frame 2k (rendered every second frame), so read the jellies' positions of frame f - f % step for where its light is in that picture

ring.note: the bell rings by itself as progress passes this frame; the sound spreads at `wave` m/s of story time (p x meta.seconds)

convention: three.js: Y up, right-handed, metres (Blender (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y)); the sea surface is y = 0. camera.q looks along local -Z, up +Y; fov = vertical degrees of the full 1280x720 frame (sensor 36 mm across); focus = planar metres to the heroes; hero.q: nose along local -Z, up +Y, right wing +X. sun.dir points up toward the refracted sun; color and ambient are linear RGB, the light left at the heroes' depth (blue only), judged against the plate.
